## Value stream: velocity

### 1. Get a bike

- Reserve a bike
  - #4 [A rider wants to reserve a bike at a bike station](rider-reserves-bike-at-station.md) (Rider, draft) → Bike Reserved
- Release an expired reservation
  - #5 [Fleet operations wants unused reservations released after they expire](fleet-operations-releases-expired-reservation.md) (Fleet Operations, draft) → Reservation Expired, Bike Available Again
- Unlock a bike
  - #1 [A rider wants to rent a bike from a bike station](rider-rents-bike-from-station.md) (Rider, delivered) → Bike Rented

### 2. Return the bike

- Return at a station
  - #2 [A rider wants to return a bike to the station it was rented from](rider-returns-bike-to-origin-station.md) (Rider, superseded) ~~(superseded)~~ → Bike Returned
  - #3 [A rider wants to return a bike to any VeloCity station](rider-returns-bike-to-any-station.md) (Rider, draft) → Bike Returned
